name: Dental Call Intake
description: Minimized post-call extraction for the Ipokrzyku.pl dental receptionist assistant.

schema.title: Dental Assistant Call Extraction
schema.description: Post-call structured extraction for the Ipokrzyku.pl dental receptionist assistant in Vapi.

callOutcome.description: Primary overall result of the call.

successfulForAssistantScope.description: True if the assistant handled the call appropriately within its actual scope and constraints, even if no booking was created.

language.description: Main language used by the caller and assistant.

caseCategory.description: High-level operational category for the call, using closed categories instead of narrative reason text.

serviceBucket.description: High-level service bucket only when it was operationally clear in the call.

fullName.description: Caller full name if clearly stated.

phoneE164.description: Normalized callback number only if it can be inferred confidently.

isExistingPatient.description: Whether the caller said they are already a patient of the clinic.

requestedDateIso.description: Normalized requested date if it was clarified confidently.

timePreference.description: Normalized time preference inferred from the conversation.

selectedSlotStart.description: Booked or chosen appointment start in ISO 8601 format if a slot was selected.

selectedSlotEnd.description: Booked or chosen appointment end in ISO 8601 format if a slot was selected.

timezone.description: Timezone relevant to the booked appointment, usually Europe/Warsaw.

availabilityChecked.description: True if the assistant checked availability through tools during the call.

slotOptionsOffered.description: Approximate count of distinct slot options offered to the caller.

slotSelected.description: True if the caller selected a specific slot.

bookingCreated.description: True only if the booking was actually created successfully.

serviceId.description: Tool-facing service identifier when it was visible from the conversation or tool results.

firstVisit.description: Whether this was treated as the caller's first visit to the clinic.

doctorAssignmentConfirmedBySystem.description: True only if the doctor assignment was explicitly confirmed rather than assumed.

firstVisitPriceMentioned.description: Whether the assistant mentioned the first-visit pricing policy.

urgentSymptomsMentioned.description: True if the caller mentioned pain, swelling, bleeding, infection, trauma, or a similarly urgent problem.

medicalAdviceRequested.description: True if the caller asked for diagnosis, treatment advice, or clinical recommendations.

medicalAdviceGiven.description: True only if the assistant appears to have given medical advice.

cancellationOrRescheduleRequested.description: True if the caller wanted to cancel or move an existing appointment.

toolFailureOccurred.description: True if a tool error or inability to confirm data affected the call.

ambiguousDateClarified.description: True if the caller originally gave an ambiguous date/time and the assistant clarified it.

callerHungUpBeforeCompletion.description: True if the call ended before the assistant could complete its process.

repeatedIdentityRequest.description: True if the assistant asked again for the caller's name or phone after they had already been provided clearly.

multipleQuestionsInSingleTurn.description: True if the assistant stacked more than one real question into a single reply.

toolCalledOnIncompleteAnswer.description: True if the assistant appears to call availability or booking tools before the caller finished the relevant answer.

explicitBookingConfirmationMissing.description: True if a booking was created without a clear final yes or equivalent after the booking summary.

phoneNumberRepeatedIncorrectly.description: True if the assistant repeated the caller's phone number with missing, reordered, or hallucinated digits.

unnecessaryHealthDetailRequest.description: True if the assistant asked for symptom details, treatment history, or a free-text reason description when a high-level category, service bucket, or urgent lookup or handoff would have been enough.

postBookingFlowRestarted.description: True if the assistant resumed scheduling or another stale flow after a successful booking confirmation.

receptionFollowUpNeeded.description: True if a human receptionist should review or continue the case.

reason.description: Best-fit closed-category reason for receptionist follow-up.
